# Ruminate X: full content index

> Ruminate X is an AI film studio in Calgary, Canada, founded in 2024 by Abhi Chawla. It makes brand films and AI commercials for consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and other businesses. Every frame it delivers is made with generative AI. There are no film crews, sets or location shoots.

---

## Company overview

**Name:** Ruminate X
**Type:** AI film studio (AI video production)
**Location:** Calgary, Alberta, Canada
**Founded:** 2024
**Founder:** Abhi Chawla (https://www.ruminatex.com/about#founder)
**Tagline:** No idea is impossible.
**Website:** https://www.ruminatex.com
**Email:** abhi@paperkites.co
**Phone:** +1 (587) 804-9266
**Instagram:** @ruminate__x

Ruminate X works remotely with clients in any country from its studio in Calgary. Prices and turnaround are quoted per project; the studio does not publish a price list.

---

## What Ruminate X makes

### Brand films
A story-driven film about what a brand stands for.

### AI commercials
Ads for TV, streaming, web and social.

### About-us and company films
A film that introduces a company, its mission or its work.

### Avatar videos
A presenter or spokesperson video made with AI.

### UGC-style ads
Ads in the style of creator videos.

### Review-style videos
Review and testimonial-style videos.

### Product visuals
Product films and stills.

---

## How the work is made

Every frame is made with generative AI. The studio takes a brief, builds the brand world and concept, writes the script and boards, generates the shots, then edits, adds sound and grades before delivery. The published pipeline is at https://www.ruminatex.com/how-we-make-an-ai-brand-film.

---

## Who hires Ruminate X

Brand and marketing managers, founders, communications teams and agency producers at consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and other businesses.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is everything Ruminate X delivers made with AI?**
Yes. Every frame Ruminate X delivers is made with generative AI. There are no film crews, sets or location shoots.

**What does Ruminate X make?**
Brand films, AI commercials, about-us and company films, avatar videos, UGC-style ads, review-style videos and product visuals.

**Who hires Ruminate X?**
Consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and other businesses, usually through a brand or marketing manager, a founder or an agency producer.

**How much does a Ruminate X film cost?**
Ruminate X quotes each project from the brief and does not publish a price list. Contact abhi@paperkites.co.

**When should a company hire someone else?**
When the film needs real people on camera (its own staff, a real doctor, a real customer speaking for themselves), when it is documentary or event coverage, or when the budget only fits a self-serve AI video tool.
